name: Prestere
body:
Prestere
CR 1

Smoke comes off this little grayish snake’s skin, and the sand sizzles below it as if all of its body was burning with a strange fever.

XP 400
N Tiny animal
Init +3; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 15, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +2 size)
hp 13 (2d8+4)
Fort +5, Ref +6, Will +1
Immune disease

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., burrow 20 ft.
Melee bite +5 (1d3-3 plus disease)
Space 2-½ ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Special Attacks disease

STATISTICS

Str 4, Dex 16, Con 15, Int 2, Wis 13, Cha 5
Base Atk +1; CMB +2; CMD 9 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Weapon Finesse
Skills Perception +9 Stealth +19; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception, +4 Stealth

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Dropsy (Ex)

The prestere’s bite is not venomous but transmits a virulent form of the disease known as dropsy, that causes high fever and a severe swelling in all the subject’s body caused by water retention. Some fonts claim that the swelling doesn’t stop even after death.

Virulent Dropsy: Bite—injury; save Fortitude DC 11; onset 1d2 hours; frequency 1 hour; effect 1d2 Dexterity damage, 1 Constitution damage, and target is slowed; cure 2 consecutive saves.

Familiar

The master of a prestere familiar gains a +2 bonus on saving throws against disease.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm deserts
Organization solitary, pair, or nest (1-4)
Treasure none

Some say that presteri are the embodiment of the desert’s heat. The disease they bear kills you by burning your body from the inside, even while swelling it with liquid.
